title: Topic 22
japanese_text: 「<u>相対的</u><u>貧困</u>率」とは、所得が国民全体の中央値の半分を<u>下回って</u>いる人々の割合を指す。日本では2023年現在上昇傾向にあるが、これには、税金は上がり続けているのに、賃金は2000年頃から<u>横ばい</u>で<u>推移して</u>いることも関係しているだろう。
english_translation: The "relative poverty rate" refers to the percentage of people whose income is less than half the median income of the population as a whole. In Japan, as of 2023, it is on an upward trend, but this is probably also due in part to the fact that wages have shifted toward leveling off since around 2000, while taxes have continued to rise.
